gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Bennetts BikeSocial (John Milbank) timed the Chigee AIO-5 Lite at 12 seconds to its home screen and another 20 seconds to load Android Auto, about 32 seconds from power-on to maps.
standout_why: I read two of the cited results: throttlebuff.com (updated 2026-11-04), which says it was 'built from manufacturer specifications, safety certifications and owner feedback rather than hands-on testing', and motorcyclegpshub.com (updated 2026-11-11), whose figures are all maker ratings such as 'rated at up to 1,000 nits'. Neither has a timed or metered figure. I could not open the four handlebarhq.com pages (SSL certificate error on fetch, and curl needed approval) or planamoto.com. So I can't rule out that Handlebar HQ's AIO-5 Lite review gives a boot time, which is why this is 2 and not 3. Chigee's maker pages give specs, not third-party timings.
decides: It confirms rather than changes the pick. Of the products ChatGPT showed, only the Chigee AIO-5 Lite has a named reviewer's timing (about 32 s to maps, 16+ h of dual-camera recording on a 256 GB card, and no phone charging needed on 4–5 hour rides). That makes it the one candidate where a shopper can see a measured cold-start delay. No reviewer has tested the battery runtime of the Aoocci F5, ChatGPT's 'portable' pick, so its approximately 10 h claim, which I only saw in search results, remains the maker's word.
